name: inner-current
description: Electrodynamic human state ontology and diagnostic machine

scripts.start: node -e "import('node:http').then(({createServer}) => import('node:fs').then(({createReadStream}) => createServer((req, res) => { res.writeHead(200, {'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8'}); createReadStream('public/index.html').pipe(res); }).listen(3333, () => console.log('⚡ Inner Current Visualizer running at http://localhost:3333'))))"
